annotations.title: Show business card designs to choose from

description: Show the user every Designprint business card design with their own details on it, so they can choose by looking. Use this first whenever the user asks for business cards and has not chosen a design. Ask for missing details beforehand only if you do not have their name; every other field is optional. It makes one real card per design (10 designs, front and back, 3.5 x 2 in) and returns, for each, its name, a one-line description, the front and back pictures and its own order link, plus a page that shows all of them and the same gallery as one self-contained HTML document. Present the result as a scrollable gallery: where the in-chat gallery is showing, point the user to it; if you can show HTML (an artifact), show the gallery document as it is; otherwise list every design with its own link and give the gallery page. Never join the designs into one picture and do not choose for the user. Each link opens that exact design on thedesignprint.com, where the user checks it, picks a quantity and pays as a guest. After they choose, use update_business_card with that design's link for changes and check_order to confirm the payment. If the user already named a design, use create_business_card instead.

accent_color.description: Hex color that replaces the design's accent, e.g. '#0E7C66'. Use the brand color if the user has one.

channel.description: Where the request comes from, e.g. 'claude', 'chatgpt', 'cursor', 'terminal'.

logo_url.description: https link to a logo image (PNG, JPG or SVG). Shown on the back and small on the front. If it cannot be loaded the card is made without it and the warnings say so.

name.description: Full name as it should appear on the card.

phone.description: Phone number, written the way it should print.

quantity.description: How many cards the user wants, if they said. There is a minimum order; a smaller number is raised to the minimum and the change is reported in the warnings. With a quantity, the result also gives the shipping options and an estimated total. It is preselected on the order page.

tagline.description: Short line shown under the company name on the back of the card.
